A small tool that does one thing well.
When your team deploys from a private Docker registry, knowing what version of an image is available shouldn't require logging into a dashboard or running CLI commands.
A small FastAPI + Nuxt.js app running locally. It connects to a private Docker registry and fetches the latest published image versions on demand. Everything stays on the machine.
Used daily by the team, maintained with minimal effort.
Latest Docker image version lookup from a private registry
Local deployment — no data leaves the machine
A local tool for Data teams — checks the latest Docker image versions published to a private registry.
Deployed locally, used daily by the team.
